delivery_method: Qualify -> Authorize -> Baseline -> Execute -> Prove -> Decide
purpose: turn an approved 30-Day Revenue Command Pilot into bounded delivery with one governed commercial-to-delivery handoff and customer-validated proof

commercial_handoff.rule: delivery workspace never creates commercial, payment, relationship, consent, or publication truth by itself

stages.name: Commercial Handoff Gate
stages.goal: accept only a qualified, authorized customer scope with explicit start/data-boundary evidence

stages.name: Baseline & Readiness
stages.goal: capture stakeholders, current state, access, risks, baseline, instrumentation, and acceptance criteria

stages.name: Bounded Workflow Blueprint
stages.goal: design one in-scope workflow without expanding commercial authority

stages.name: Governed 30-Day Delivery
stages.goal: execute the approved workflow with deterministic controls, approval receipts, failure handling, and weekly evidence

stages.name: Weekly Proof & Command
stages.goal: reconcile activity, delivery, outcome, risk, approval, and evidence without promoting estimates into value

stages.name: Final Proof Pack
stages.goal: separate delivery, payment, customer value, and publication permission and assemble only verified evidence

stages.name: Stop / Expand / Redesign
stages.goal: make the Day-30 decision from verified evidence; any expansion is a new bounded scope and customer-specific commercial decision

delivery_guardrails: no clients/<slug> delivery workspace without commercial handoff/start evidence except explicit synthetic test mode
no scope expansion without new acceptance criteria and commercial authority
no sensitive data access without documented need and approved data boundary
no material external action without current action-bound authority and channel gates
no delivery claim without delivery evidence
no customer-value claim without customer confirmation
no public reuse without publication permission
proof pack required before Stop/Expand/Redesign decision
